name: setup-milty-slice-after-faction-order
description: Live pbd223 stall (08:48): a milty drafter already holding a faction and a speaker position owes a slice, while the slice board was last touched several picks earlier. In pbd223 the slice board's decision had been closed as obsolete mid-draft (a half-loaded MiltyDraftManager seen by a concurrent edit capture), only the faction / speaker boards stayed open, the bot pressed those, both were refused ('You already drafted…') and the draft never advanced (pbd223's own saves are pruned; same situation from pbd108). Here: seat3 (Bot Beta) takes Last Bastion and seat2's last speaker position is auto-picked; seat4 (Bot Gamma: muaat + 1st) must be able to take slice C through the engine (stops before the last pick: finishing the draft assigns colours at random).
